description: Adelaide Public Transport Stop Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. The dataset contains public transport stop data for buses, trains and trams in shapefile, geojson and kml format. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are bus, bus stops, esri, public transport, shapefile. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, MAP VIEWER, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
